The Overlord is vulnerable to the **Magma Pulse Resonator**. When the player holds the Resonator and fires the Flameflame Cannon *in sync with the pillar's pulse*, a chain reaction activates.
Holy Flame (from Holy Avenger's Sword) | 2x damage on hit, critical on full stack of flame effect

Vulnerable to the Molten Sledgehammer's fire burst. Fire burst deals 35% extra damage and burns for 3 seconds

The player's Crystal Shard of the First Flame. When the shard is active and the Echo-Drift is hit with the Resonance Torch, it causes a feedback loop that temporarily disables the Echo-Drift for 3 seconds.

encounters.weakness: Lightning (player weapon - Lightning Staff). Direct lightning strikes cause 2x damage and stun for 1.5 seconds. Vulnerable to 3 consecutive hits from the staff in close range.
Lava Shatter Shard (pickup from previous encounter). When the shard is active, a single use of 'Shatter Blast' reduces the Stalker's health by 45% and forces it to stagger for 3 seconds.
Ash Siphon Core (pickup from previous encounter). When activated, the core causes the Sentinel to emit a visible static wave that shatters its ash shields and causes it to freeze for 4 seconds.
The player's Lava-Stick — when the stick is swung at the frog, it makes a *bloop* sound and the frog jumps in a silly loop, weakening it by 10% each time.
The Bubble Blower — when a bubble is released in the air, the fireflies spin and scatter, becoming disoriented.
The Frost-Lily — when the player places the lily on the ground, it emits a gentle frost pulse that freezes the marmoset's tail, making it wobble and unable to swing its arms.
Chrono-Siphon (player weapon). When hit by Chrono-Siphon, it shudders and its ash cloud collapses, temporarily freezing it in place for 2 seconds.

Time Shard (pickup from previous encounter). When the player uses the Time Shard, the enemy splits into two phases. The Time Shard weakens the first phase, causing the golem to shatter into pieces and become vulnerable.
Time Resonance Core (specific pickup from the second encounter). When the player activates the Time Resonance Core, the boss enters a 10-second time-loop where it repeats its movement in reverse.
Luminous Cross of Aelthar — the cross's radiant pulse inflicts 2x damage when used at full charge.
The player's 'Resonant Step' pickup — when the player moves on the platform, the spider's webbing shivers. After 10 seconds of movement, it becomes vulnerable for 3 seconds.
The **Shard of Harmonic Echo** — when the player uses the shard's passive (Resonant Step) in sequence (3 times within 10 seconds), Aethelis becomes vulnerable to radiant damage.
Chrono-Claw (Time-Slice ability). The Echo is vulnerable to attacks that slice time and disrupt its temporal echo loop. A single successful time-slice from the Chrono-Claw shatters the echo's loop.
Fragment of Stillness. The Vulture attacks by consuming time from its prey. When the player uses the Fragment of Stillness to create a stasis bubble, the Vulture's time-drain attacks are nullified.
Tachyon Echo. The Chronophage absorbs time from the environment. When the Tachyon Echo is used, it creates a tachyonic shockwave that disrupts the Chronophage's internal time structure.
Shadow Edge (direct strike during pulse phase, 20% chance to shatter form and reduce damage by 40%)
Fragile Shard of the Shattered Sky (placed on the enemy's phase node triggers 15-second vulnerability: all damage reduced by 50%, and phase resistance drops to 20%)
inventory: Fragile Shard of the Shattered Sky

encounters.weakness: Echo of the First Shade (held during pulse phase, player must mirror the enemy's pulse to freeze it. 5-second freeze, no damage taken during freeze)

Luminous Dust (when used to create a glowing ring, the moth reflects it and crashes into itself)
Stabilized Luminous Core (must create a glowing orb in the center — the sky weeper sees it as a true self and collapses)

Stormfist Overload Mode (activated by sustained lightning pulses from the Stormfist). When the Stormfist is used in rapid succession for over 2 seconds, it triggers a backlash that deals 50% more damage.
The Nebula Shard. When the Void-Spinner is attacked with the Nebula Shard equipped, its core emits a dissonant frequency that causes it to freeze for 2 seconds.
The Nebula Shard must be equipped *and* the player must have used the Stormfist's Overload Mode *at least once* during the earlier encounters.
Starburst shot (from Luminous Bow)
Focus Pulse (requires Fragment of the First Light)
Frost Shard (must be used during a red pulse phase to trigger Resonant Freeze)
Glowing Tesseract Core (sustained pulse over 3 seconds; pulse must be continuous to disable phase-shifting).
Fractured Resonance Shard (must be activated in the Harmonic Resonator; device must be fully charged and active).
Harmonic Resonator activated using the Fractured Resonance Shard + Stitched Circuit Core. Must be sustained for 10 seconds with uninterrupted pulses.
The player's Gravity Clamp can destabilize its energy core. When used within 2 tiles of the enemy, it triggers a critical override and deals 50% extra damage.
The Fracture Golem is weak to the Stabilized Core Fragment. When the player uses the fragment on the enemy, it causes a micro-surge in its internal structure, reducing its health by 30%.
The Void Nexus is vulnerable to the Phase Resonator Disk. When the player uses the disk, it emits a harmonic frequency that disrupts the enemy's energy field.
